name: function length counts leading parameters
source: function f(a: number, b: number): void {} function h(a: number = 1, b: number): void {} function r(a: number, ...rest: number[]): void {} function o(a?: number): void {} function z(...r: number[]): void {} function main(): void { console.log(f.length, h.length, r.length, o.length, z.length); }
